page.notes: Reference marks a, b, c, d are printed in the text as superscript letters and repeated in the left margin. "anima fua" and "Dei ac Mariae" are read as printed; "fua" is not fully certain. The margin reading "1.Cor.1.30" may be "I.Cor.1.30" in print. The word "veniam" at lower right is a catchword and is therefore not in the text. The running head was printed in capitals with V for U, changed to U per the rules.
